name: Catalog Motion with References
description: Upload a product catalog as CSV and every product becomes a short video made from reference images: the product's own photo, plus a background and a decoration image you add once for the whole catalog. One prompt template fills from each row's columns, and you test a single product before you pay for the batch. Every clip is saved to your assets.

props.subtitle: Animate your product catalog with your own backdrop and props.

props.text: 💸 Video is metered per second. Test one product before you render a range.

props.subtitle: One product per row, with a header row. Each row needs a link to the product's photo.

props.text: A Shopify, WooCommerce or spreadsheet export works as it is. Leave the column fields blank and the app finds the image and name columns.

props.title: The catalog could not be read

props.subtitle: Both images are optional and apply to every product. Each product's own photo is always image 1.

props.text: The background is image 2. The decoration is image 3, or image 2 when you add no background.

props.subtitle: One template for the whole catalog. Each product's own values fill it in.

props.text: Read the catalog, then click a field below the prompt to insert its placeholder. You can also type {{column}}, for example {{title}} or {{color}}. Name the images with {{product_image}}, {{background_image}} and {{decoration_image}}. The model gets them in that order: image 1 is the product, then the background, then the decoration. A reference you leave out is skipped, and its placeholder is removed from the prompt.

props.title: The template does not fit the catalog

props.subtitle: Every product is animated from its reference images with these settings.

props.text: Not every model offers every frame, resolution and length. A model that does not support a setting uses its closest one.

props.subtitle: Render one row with the exact settings the batch will use.
Animate a run of rows. Clips appear as they finish and are saved to your assets.

props.label: Last row (0 renders to the end)

props.text: 💸 Each row is one clip. The summary shows how many clips and seconds the range adds up to.
Every clip is saved as an asset with the prompt and settings that made it, so you can find it later or make a variant.

data.comment:
# Read a Product Catalog

Reads a product catalog CSV and shows what each row would be animated with.

**How it works:** "Catalog CSV" takes the file. "Read the catalog" detects the delimiter, finds the image and name columns when the fields are blank, and fills "Prompt template" for every row. Write `{{title}}` or `{{color}}` to insert that column's value. "Products" is the table and "Summary" names the columns you can use.

**Try this:** Upload a Shopify product export and leave both column fields blank. It finds `Image Src` and `Title`.

data.comment:
# Animate a Product Catalog with References

Animates a range of rows from a product catalog CSV with Reference To Video. Every product's own photo is image 1. "Background image" and "Decoration image" are optional and follow it in that order.

**How it works:** "Read the rows to animate" fills "Prompt template" for each row and keeps `{{product_image}}`, `{{background_image}}` and `{{decoration_image}}`. "References and prompt" builds the image list and turns each placeholder into `image N` by its place in the list. A placeholder for an image you leave out is removed. "Animate" runs the chosen reference-to-video model, and "Videos" streams the clips in as they finish.

**Try this:** Leave out the background. The decoration becomes image 2.
